title: Neo humanoid maker 1X releases world model to help bots learn what they see
description: 1X released a new world model that it says is a solid step toward its robots being able to teach themselves new tasks.
author: Rebecca Szkutak

title: ElevenLabs CEO says the voice AI startup crossed $330M ARR last year
description: The company said it took only five months to go from $200 million to $330 million in annual recurring revenue.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Apple launches ‘Creator Studio’ bundle of apps for $12.99 per month
description: The bundle includes access to Final Cut Pro, Logic Pro, and Pixelmator Pro on Mac and iPad, as well as Motion, Compressor, and MainStage on Mac.
author: Aisha Malik

title: Deepgram raises $130M at $1.3B valuation and buys a YC AI startup
description: Deepgram is raising its Series C round at a $1.3 billion valuation.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Slackbot is an AI agent now
description: Salesforce unveils Slackbot, a new AI agent that allows users to complete tasks across multiple enterprise applications from Slack.
author: Rebecca Szkutak

title: Brazil orders Meta to suspend policy banning third-party AI chatbots from WhatsApp
description: Brazil's competition watchdog has ordered WhatsApp to put on hold its policy that bars third-party AI companies from using its business API to offer chatbots on the app. The agency has also started an investigation against the company to determine if the policy is anti-competitive.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Converge Bio raises $25M, backed by Bessemer and execs from Meta, OpenAI, Wiz
description: AI drug discovery startup Converge Bio raised $25 million in a Series A led by Bessemer Venture Partners, with additional backing from executives at Meta, OpenAI, and Wiz.
author: Kate Park

title: Meta-backed Hupo finds growth after pivot to AI sales coaching from mental wellness
description: Hupo, backed by Meta, pivoted from mental wellness to AI sales coaching for banks and insurers, and secured a $10M Series A led by DST Global
author: Kate Park

title: Hands-on with Bee, Amazon’s latest AI wearable
description: We tried Amazon's new AI wearable Bee. It's not for pro users yet, but more features are expected this year.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Why Amazon bought Bee, an AI wearable
description: Amazon explains where its wearable Bee fits in and whether it will merge with Alexa.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Mark Zuckerberg says Meta is launching its own AI infrastructure initiative
description: Meta is ramping up its efforts to build out its AI capacity — Zuckerberg said the company intended to drastically expand its energy footprint in the coming years.
author: Lucas Ropek

title: Anthropic announces Claude for Healthcare following OpenAI’s ChatGPT Health reveal
description: Anthropic's Claude for Healthcare is unveiled about a week after OpenAI announced its ChatGPT Health product.
author: Amanda Silberling
